hook: Excess luminophore lets light-emission microscopy image depth, revealing 3D shape of algae and spheroids.
hook_turn: revealing 3D shape of algae and spheroids.
summary: Raising the ruthenium luminophore to coreactant ratio lets the glowing layer drift away from the electrode over time, and objects that block this light reveal their depth. Simulations and scanning electrochemical microscopy back the diffusion picture, and spirulina and cell spheroids served as demos. Only insulating micro-to-mesoscale objects were tested.
title: Diffusional depth profiling using electrochemiluminescence microscopy.
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
